title: StreamShared::stopped AtomicBool is a stage flag set from stop(), end(), on_stopped() and the failed-start path
trigger: share a window on macOS, close it while the user also presses stop
effect: none today (swap makes Ended once); Windows twin uses CaptureStage enum, mac keeps a bool

title: StreamFeeder::drain drops the time requests waiting in StreamsSync::Asking without answering them, though its doc says no engine request is left waiting
trigger: RTMP stream, a time request is waiting on getGroupCallStreams, the call is replaced (rejoin) and drain runs
effect: the time waiters (BroadcastRequestId) are forgotten, never answered; harmless only because the old native instance is destroyed right after
fix: answer the waiters with 0 in drain (answer_time_waiters) before setting StreamsSync::Idle

title: WatchStage::Reopened is terminal after a reopen that worked: a second output failure later in the same stream is never healed
trigger: stream plays, output fails once and the reopen works, the device drops again 10 minutes later
effect: stream stays silent until the call window closes; observe() returns None forever from Reopened/GaveUp
fix: leave Reopened back to Watching once the reopened output has shown sound (health.frames advanced), so the rule is per output, not per stream
